svg.text: 29 Oct 2026 · three Strands agents talking A2A on Kubernetes · the Guard in enforce mode · Cognee, a memory for Claude Code, in the same namespace · the numbers follow one task, from your request to Claude Code
both ways: an A2A task that
flows by itself: traces, files, images
you, the knowledge base, Cognee memory
② the CLI talks A2A to the orchestrator
③ the Guard checks the request
⑤ Grimoire documents (and seen before, D47)
⑥ evidence on your laptop, read-only
⑦ the shield scores evidence and documents
⑧ you approve: the Cedar lock
Cognee web UI in your browser:
shows the prompt; sends it only after yes
runs the approved prompt in your repo
the result goes back to the agent
set up with no capture and no LLM

text.tspan: · kubeadm · 5 nodes × 8 CPU / 24 GB · CPU only, no GPU

svg.text: starts the model pod on demand
SHA-256 checked by the health-check command
only the proxy may reach it
after a Grafana restart: the Grafana setup command
Grafana only reads the traces: no request,
evidence or prompt ever reaches it.
1–6 CPU · ONNX: a score per part
Strands Agent + A2A server on 127.0.0.1:9000 · a fixed planner: no model decides the order of the steps
③ request: your 20 rules, then Granite (only stricter),
malicious / out of scope → blocked · risky or flagged → y/N
⑦ evidence + documents: rules cut, then the shield cuts
⑧ Cedar lock: only the exact prompt you approved runs
built with Strands interventions, aux_model and Cedar
an open task ends after 120 min
network rules: each pod reaches only what it needs
ServiceAccount wattson-reader: view, for your kubectl
one pod, 3 containers · Cognee 1.6.5 · made by the Cognee setup command, not by the deploy command
the only owner of the stores
volume wattson-cognee-data · 10 Gi on my-storage-class · SQLite, LanceDB, Ladybug
graph step (GLiNER) off: it ran out of memory
no LLM · nothing leaves the pod · telemetry off
Secret wattson-cognee: UI password, API key
network rule: in from orchestrator + knowledge,
MCP port 8000 only · out: DNS only
no Ingress: API and UI by port-forward only
⑤ D47, not deployed yet: one MCP recall, read-only · CHUNKS · claude_code_memory · 5 s timeout
up to 3 lessons, checked like Grimoire documents → prompt part "Seen before (Cognee memory)"
kubectl port-forward (the Cognee setup command), 127.0.0.1 only:
Granite: checked by the health-check command
newer ones in the repo: not published yet
the wattson images, pulled by the cluster
No model on your laptop · the agents hold no cluster credentials (kubectl runs on your laptop) · nothing runs without your yes · traces hold no text
D47 (seen before) is in the code, not deployed yet · Cognee is not part of a task's flow: Claude Code uses it on its own, through the port-forward (D44–D46)
